violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed cold water is not available at the hand sink across from the three compartment sink. No cold water comes out when the fixture is turned on. The hot water at this sink is 134º, or very hot, and may be too hot for employees to wash their hands without being able to temper it with cold water.
violations.corrective_action: Please have the cold water supply restored at this hand sink as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: steak and shrimp for fajitas on the serving line were 108º and 132º, respectively and being held without temperature control for 2.5 hours. The establishment policy is to discard all food on the serving line at the end of the serving period.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS instructed the manager to discard the items in no more than 1.5 hours. Manager has requested the use of TPHC moving forward. A TPHC procedure was created and entered into the establishment record. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: house-made guacamole was 60º F on the serving line and being held without temperature control for 2.5 hours steak and shrimp for fajitas on the serving line were 108º and 132º, respectively and being held without temperature control for 2.5 hours. The establishment policy is to discard all food on the serving line at the end of the serving period.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS instructed the manager to discard the items in no more than 1.5 hours. Manager has requested the use of TPHC moving forward. A TPHC procedure was created and entered into the establishment record. CDI.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonia solution at the three vat sink was measured at 500ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quat solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. The manager will contact the vendor to have the dispenser calibrated and will dilute the solution with water and check with a test kit before using. CDI.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served or sold in a ready-to-eat form without freezing for parasite destruction is not properly identified as such: smoked salmon.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form and the fish is raised and fed as specified by Law, a written agreement or statement from the supplier or aquaculturist stipulating that the fish were raised and fed shall be obtained by the person in charge and retained in the records for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. Please email parasite destruction letter or provide documentation that the smoked salmon is ready to eat to EHS within 10 days.
